description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC? 

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

 Pay and Benefits:   

 
 Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive 

 Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location 

 Pension / Retirement benefits 

 Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 

 DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

 
 The impact you will have in this role: 

 As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) , you will be part of a business-aligned development squad responsible for building, enhancing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. 

 This role combines software development and test engineering, with a strong emphasis on Core Java programming, technical problem-solving, and automation development . You will design and develop scalable automated testing solutions across UI, API, and backend systems while applying software engineering principles to improve quality, reliability, and testability. 

 The ideal candidate is a hands-on Java programmer who can independently write, debug, and maintain code and apply those development skills to build robust, scalable, and maintainable test automation solutions. 

 Your Primary Responsibilities: 

 
 Design, develop, and maintain Java-based test automation frameworks and solutions across UI, API, and backend applications.  

 Write clean, reusable, and maintainable Java code using object-oriented programming principles and software engineering best practices.  

 Solve programming and technical problems using Core Java, appropriate data structures, fundamental algorithms, and object-oriented design principles.  

 Develop automated tests using technologies such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, and Rest Assured.  

 Build scalable UI automation solutions using design patterns such as the Page Object Model (POM).  

 Develop API automation and validate RESTful services using Rest Assured or similar technologies.  

 Perform backend and database validation using SQL, JDBC, and relational databases.  

 Debug application and automation code to identify defects, test failures, and underlying root causes.  

 Develop and optimize complex SQL queries for data validation and backend testing.  

 Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using technologies such as Jenkins, CloudBees, Bitbucket, and Git.  

 Contribute to automated testing across integration, API, functional, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing while partnering with developers to strengthen unit-test coverage.  

 Apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices where appropriate.  

 Collaborate with software developers, product owners, and engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.  

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

 
 **NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. ** 

 Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

 6+ years of experience in Software Development Engineering in Test, test automation engineering, software development, or a related technical discipline.  

 Significant hands-on experience developing automation solutions and frameworks using Java . 

 Experience testing complex enterprise applications across UI, API, and backend layers. 

 
 Talent Needed for Success 

 
 Strong hands-on Core Java programming skills, with the ability to independently write, debug, and explain Java code.  

 Strong understanding and practical application of Core Java concepts, including:  
 
 Object-oriented programming principles, including inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, and encapsulation 

 Collections, data structures, and fundamental algorithms 

 Exception handling 

 Strings and common data-manipulation techniques 

 Streams and Lambda expressions 

 Multithreading and concurrency 

 Reusable and maintainable code design 

 

 Strong programming and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply data structures and fundamental algorithms to practical coding challenges.  

 Hands-on experience designing, developing, and enhancing Java-based test automation frameworks, rather than solely executing or maintaining existing automated test suites.  

 Experience with Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, or comparable Java-based automation technologies. 

 Strong experience with API testing and automation using Rest Assured or similar technologies.  

 Experience with Maven or Gradle and dependency management.  

 Strong SQL skills with experience performing backend and data validation against relational databases such as Oracle, DB2, or Snowflake.  

 Experience using JDBC or similar database connectivity technologies for backend data validation.  

 Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with technologies such as Jenkins, CloudBees, Bitbucket, and Git.  

 Understanding of TDD, BDD, and modern software testing practices.  

 Strong debugging, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.  

 Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively within an Agile development team. 

 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 Experience with AWS or another cloud environment.  

 Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.  

 Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.  

 Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.  

 Experience supporting applications within financial services or another regulated enterprise environment. 

 
 The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 



 
 With over 50 years of experience, DTCC is the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry. From 20 locations around the world, DTCC, through its subsidiaries, automates, centralizes, and standardizes the processing of financial transactions, mitigating risk, increasing transparency, enhancing performance and driving efficiency for thousands of broker/dealers, custodian banks and asset managers. Industry owned and governed, the firm innovates purposefully, simplifying the complexities of clearing, settlement, asset servicing, transaction processing, trade reporting and data services across asset classes, bringing enhanced resilience and soundness to existing financial markets while advancing the digital asset ecosystem. In 2024, DTCC’s subsidiaries processed securities transactions valued at U.S. $3.7 quadrillion and its depository subsidiary provided custody and asset servicing for securities issues from over 150 countries and territories valued at U.S. $99 trillion. DTCC’s Global Trade Repository service, through locally registered, licensed, or approved trade repositories, processes more than 25 billion messages annually. To learn more, please visit us at  www.dtcc.com  or connect with us on  LinkedIn ,  X ,  YouTube ,  Facebook  and  Instagram .


 DTCC proudly supports Flexible Work Arrangements favoring openness and gives people freedom to do their jobs well, by encouraging diverse opinions and emphasizing teamwork.  When you join our team, you’ll have an opportunity to make meaningful contributions at a company that is recognized as a thought leader in both the financial services and technology industries. A DTCC career is more than a good way to earn a living. It’s the chance to make a difference at a company that’s truly one of a kind.
